description: Probably, Kyiv was attacked for the first time by the new Russian jet drones "Geran-5", - military publications write. These UAVs are more similar to cruise missiles in terms of characteristics and design: they develop a speed of up to 600 km/h, carry about 90 kg of explosives and can cover up to 1000 km. Previously, such drones attacked Sumy and Chernihiv.
